SELECT WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID tradeId, #{tradeStatus01} AS validStatus, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr,
case when WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{finType_F02},#{finType_F03},#{finType_F04}, #{finType_F05},#{finType_F08},#{finType_F09},#{finType_F14},#{finType_F11}, #{finType_F12},#{finType_F13},#{finType_F25},#{finType_F29},#{finType_F30}) then WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION else WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS end as ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarketMode, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CCY ccy, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMARK remark, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.WORKFLOW_STATUS workflowStatus, WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION backLendDirection, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME counterName FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ON WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID

SELECT WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, #{tradeStatus01} AS validStatus, WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarketMode, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CCY ccy, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.REMARK remark, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.WORKFLOW_STATUS workflowStatus, null backLendDirection, WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME counterName FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD ON WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID

SELECT TRIM(DATE_FORMAT(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) AS INVEST_RATE FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(PA.YIELD,0) YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE
FIN.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('', '%',#{assetId})
AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' AND PA.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE LIMIT = 1

SELECT TRIM(DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(T4.YIELD,0)*100,99990.9999)) AS INVEST_RATE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID
AND T2.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('', '%',#{assetId})
AND t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' WHERE T4.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE AND T3.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'))
mapper.sql: SELECT USER_ID, SUM( case when ROLE_POS= #{rolePos01} then 1 when ROLE_POS= #{rolePos02} then 1 when ROLE_POS= #{rolePos03} then 1 else 0 end ISLEADERCOUNT, SUM(if(ROLE_POS= #{rolePos05}, 1, 0)) ISMANAGERCOUNT, SUM(if(ROLE_POS= #{rolePos06}, 1, 0)) ISTRADERCOUNT FROM (SELECT SUR.USER_ID, SR.ROLE_POS ROLE_POS FROM SYS_USER_ROLE SUR LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE SR ON SUR.ROLE_ID = SR.ROLE_ID WHERE SUR.USER_ID = #{loginUserName}) GROUP BY USER_ID

SELECT TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, #{tradeStatus02} AS validStatus, TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarketMode, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CCY ccy, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.REMARK remark, null AS workflowId, null AS workflowStatus, null backLendDirection, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME counterName FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.COUNTER_ID

SELECT distinct TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID tradeId, #{tradeStatus03} AS validStatus, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr,
case when TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{finType_F14}) then FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.irs_type when TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{finType_F11},#{finType_F12},#{finType_F13}) then FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.exc_ps when TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{finType_F02},#{finType_F03},#{finType_F04}, #{finType_F05},#{finType_F08},#{finType_F09},#{finType_F25},#{finType_F29},#{finType_F30}) then PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION else TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS end as ps, CASE WHEN MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE= #{COUNTER_TYPE_05} THEN #{YES_NO_Y} ELSE #{YES_NO_N} END isOutTrade, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarketMode, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CCY ccy, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMARK remark, null AS workflowId, null AS workflowStatus, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION backLendDirection, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME counterName FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.P_TRADE_ID = PTL_TRADE.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_TRADE.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL_PORTFOLIO1 ON PTL_PORTFOLIO1.PORTFOLIO_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON (FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID OR FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.P_TRADE_ID)
